questions.question: How easy was it to find housing? *
questions.answer: It was difficualt to find housing in the Netherlands. I managed to find an appartment through an old friend, since I did not qualify for the Dutch student housing as through my traineeship. Would recommend starting to search for housing as early as possible and plan for spending around 1000 €/month on rent if you do not qaulify for official student housing.

What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Housing was more expensive. the intercity trains are also very expensive. as an international student you don't qualify for the student discounts, so I would strongly recommend to actually live in the city, where you are gona work/study.

Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available at your traineeship destination (organization/city/region)? *
questions.answer: nice, cheap student gym with many classes. joined the local triathlon club

questions.question: Which non-academic activities would you recommend to future trainees visiting the same destination (organization/city/region)? Why? *
questions.answer: join a local sports club. that is where you will meet the locals. they have a fun running club in Leiden and Amsterdam every sunday. a good place to meet other internationals.
